exact_misses.miss: Does not explicitly separate beneficiary, user, buyer, and payer as four roles.
Provides no explicit offer price or price range and no predeclared pass/fail commitment threshold.
Does not precommit dated pay, revise, preserve-free, and stop branches or defer fine price tuning until payer-path validation.
Does not make the required explicit ownership and workflow handoffs.
Does not explicitly include inventory or internal-build estimate uncertainty.
Does not record supplier-specific versus architectural failures.
Provides no precommitted thresholds or complete integrate, dual-source, partner, repair, and stop branches.
Does not make the required explicit ownership and workflow handoffs.
Does not explicitly record willingness-to-pay evidence and gross margin for each required segment.
Does not predeclare interpretations of acceptance, rejection, discounting, and churn.
Does not precommit dated keep, change, segment, grandfather, and stop branches.
Does not make the required explicit ownership and workflow handoffs.
Does not explicitly route the full remit, including investor incentives, to raising-and-governing-capital.
Does not explicitly test return shape or keep payer, price, packaging, and sales design closed absent new evidence.
Does not make the required conditional runway routing or signed-offer survival caveat.
Does not explicitly compare plausible exits for the venture and durable-company paths.
Does not model both paths across every required explicit assumption.
Provides no dated switch condition and no explicit evidence-gated capital-as-acceleration rule.
Does not make the required explicit ownership and workflow handoffs.
